lanes.confirm_path: Spectroscopic f(M) from >=3 archival RV epochs at the known Gaia period, consistent with mMRF + single-lined + pure ellipsoidal ZTF curve = corroborated dark companion; K1 inconsistency = refutation. All archive-only — K1~100-300 km/s, so even R~1800 LRS RVs discriminate.
lanes.novelty_argument: Attacks the documented wall head-on: roster is P>100 d, this pool is hours-days, exactly where NSS is structurally blind. Even all-refuted, the refutation-rate is a citable population row.

gaps.why_it_matters: The portfolio pivoted from object-hunting to publishing, but the review never audited whether the repo can actually publish cleanly; the stale-citation defect would propagate into the first external artifact.

gaps.what: No operations/time-axis plan for the 6-month pre-DR4 window: no standing scoop monitor (arXiv/ADS alerts) on the 4 novel candidates despite Shahaf/Yamaguchi/El-Badry actively working the same NSS pool; no scheduled archival-rv-monitor cadence keyed to upcoming survey DRs; no Rubin-watchlist revisit trigger; no DR4-slip contingency. 'eROSITA-east' is repeatedly treated as scheduled fresh data when it is IKI-held with no public release date.
gaps.why_it_matters: The single 'no 2026 publications' WebSearch is a snapshot, not a monitor; a one-paper scoop on WDJ060042 or UCAC4 313 during the wait would erase most remaining project EV, and cheap standing automation exists in-repo.

gaps.what: Bright-star time-domain photometry was never swept as a modality: the pool is G≈6-13 where ZTF saturates, yet ASAS-SN and ATLAS forced photometry (decade baselines, the only unsaturated coverage of this regime) appear nowhere in docs, CATALOG_DEPENDENCIES, the 36 ideas, or the drop list; likewise deeper archival UV (XMM-OM SUSS, Swift-UVOT SSC) was used once in one dossier but never adopted where GALEX AIS was too shallow (e.g. WDJ020915's non-detection).
gaps.why_it_matters: A pool-wide ASAS-SN/ATLAS eclipse/outburst/long-period-variability screen is a cheap no-telescope self-audit of the Tier-1 roster in exactly the magnitude range every existing photometric lane was blind to.
